comment: wizcmds.c sanity_check() reporting a state C really reaches: an Archeologist leashes her little dog, then level-teleports into the tutorial, which puts her inventory away while the dog stays leashed, so mon.c sanity_check_single_mon() prints "monst N: leashed but no leash for little dog" before each command. ESC, ^R (a CMD_INSANE row) and an unknown command each set iflags.sanity_no_check in cmd.c rhack(), so the check after each of them is skipped and prints nothing. She kills the dog with a wished-for wand of death and teleports back; the restored leash names a dead monster, so mkobj.c objlist_sanity() reports it and its doname() first prints objnam.c's "leashed monster #N not found". Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
